blurb: The museum that decided what modern art was, founded in 1929 by three collectors.

facts.t: MoMA bought Van Gogh's The Starry Night in 1941. He painted it in June 1889 from his window at the asylum in Saint-Rémy, partly from memory.

Les Demoiselles d'Avignon, which Picasso kept rolled up in his studio for years because even his friends were shocked, was bought by MoMA in 1939. Frida Kahlo's Self-Portrait with Cropped Hair is in the collection too.
